purpose: Turn the qualified generic nine-dimensional SO(3) Poisson quotient into an explicit Hamiltonian leaf model for nonzero and zero angular momentum.
goal: Implement and independently qualify the regular non-collinear body-frame coordinates (r,x,y,pr,px,py,ell_x,ell_y,ell_z), their Poisson tensor, Newtonian Hamiltonian, analytic gradient, and reduced flow.
evidence_boundary: A PASS qualifies one orientation-fixed chart on the regular non-collinear translation-reduced quotient. Nonzero |ell| leaves are eight-dimensional and the ell=0 leaf is six-dimensional. The chart excludes rho=0, collinearity y=0, all collision singularities, singular orbit types, and any claim of a global Darboux atlas.

model.momentum_map: ell=rho cross p_rho + lambda cross p_lambda in the moving body frame
model.poisson_structure: canonical on (r,x,y,pr,px,py) and minus body Lie-Poisson on ell, so ell_dot=ell cross dH/dell
model.leaves: T*B times S^2_mu for mu>0; T*B at ell=0
model.hamiltonian: translation-reduced Newtonian kinetic plus pair potential for arbitrary finite positive masses and G>0

theorem_obligations.R1: Derive and implement the exact forward and inverse cotangent momentum maps.
theorem_obligations.R2: Prove coordinate roundtrip and angular-momentum preservation on the declared chart.
theorem_obligations.R3: Implement the antisymmetric rank-eight/rank-six Poisson tensor and prove its Casimir |ell|^2.
theorem_obligations.R4: Derive the reduced Hamiltonian and prove energy equality with the qualified 12D Jacobi model.
theorem_obligations.R5: Derive every analytic Hamiltonian-gradient component and compare with source-disjoint finite differences.
theorem_obligations.R6: Prove the Hamiltonian vector field equals the pushed independently qualified quotient flow.
theorem_obligations.R7: Prove nonzero-leaf Casimir tangency and exact invariance of ell=0.
theorem_obligations.R8: Prove the zero leaf reduces to the canonical six-dimensional planar shape Hamiltonian in this chart.
theorem_obligations.R9: Reject chart singularities, collisions, invalid masses, invalid G, and off-leaf declarations.
theorem_obligations.R10: State the regular-stratum, local-chart, and no-global-atlas boundary.

independent_validation.reference: Source-disjoint finite-difference Hamiltonian and direct coordinate differentiation that must not import production.

adversarial_controls: Detect a sign reversal in the body Lie-Poisson block.
Reject y=0, r=0, a binary collision, invalid masses, and invalid G.
Detect falsely assigning an eight-dimensional leaf to ell=0.
Reject a reference implementation that imports production.

decision_policy.PASS: Every prerequisite, source, transform, Poisson, Hamiltonian, gradient, flow, leaf, adversarial, and boundary gate passes under a frozen implementation.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: The project has an independently qualified explicit Hamiltonian model of the regular non-collinear SO(3) Poisson quotient, including every nonzero angular-momentum symplectic leaf and the regular zero-angular-momentum leaf, in the declared body-frame chart.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_GLOBAL_CLAIM: The implementation is a global SO(3) reduction including collinear configurations and collisions.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_DARBOUX_CLAIM: All nine quotient coordinates form one canonical Darboux chart.

invalidation: Any changed chart, sign convention, source, prerequisite, Hamiltonian, tolerance, obligation, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1.
